proof:
Source: parent proof, step 8 (estimate). The parent integrates d(x) = N(ω(x) − β(x)) as a Bochner integral. Here it is compared only through lower integrals, so no measurability of β is needed.

Notation: N := covectorEuclideanNorm, h(x) := ξ(x)(ω(x)), d(x) := N(ω(x) − β(x)) ≥ 0. Let G be the set of x where |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ N(α) for every α and ξ(x)(β(x)) = 1. By hypothesis, ν-a.e. x lies in G.

1. Measurability of h.
- The evaluation map (L, a) ↦ L(a), from MultiVector P n × Covector (Euclid P) n to ℝ, is a bounded bilinear map (isBoundedBilinearMap_apply), hence continuous.
- x ↦ (ξ(x), ω(x)) is ν-a.e. strongly measurable, because ξ is and ω is continuous (AEStronglyMeasurable.prodMk).
- So h is ν-a.e. strongly measurable. Lean: isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hξ.prodMk hω.aestronglyMeasurable). ContinuousLinearMap.aestronglyMeasurable_comp₂ with ContinuousLinearMap.id does not elaborate here, and continuous_eval fails because no ContinuousEval instance is found.
2. Integrability of h. For x ∈ G, |h(x)| ≤ N(ω(x)) ≤ 1 (take α = ω(x)). The constant 1 is ν-integrable because ν is finite. So h is ν-integrable (Integrable.mono' with integrable_const).
3. Pointwise bounds. Let x ∈ G.
- (a) h(x) ≤ |h(x)| ≤ 1, so 1 − h(x) ≥ 0.
- (b) By linearity of ξ(x), h(x) = ξ(x)(β(x)) + ξ(x)(ω(x) − β(x)) = 1 + ξ(x)(ω(x) − β(x)) ≥ 1 − |ξ(x)(ω(x) − β(x))| ≥ 1 − N(ω(x) − β(x)) = 1 − d(x).
- Hence 0 ≤ 1 − h(x) ≤ d(x) for ν-a.e. x.
4. The integral of 1 − h. 1 − h is ν-integrable, and ∫(1 − h) dν = ν(ℝ^P).toReal·1 − ∫ h dν = ν(ℝ^P).toReal − ∫ h dν. This uses integral_sub, integral_const, and ν.real univ = (ν univ).toReal (measureReal_def).
5. Comparison with d.
- 1 − h is integrable and ≥ 0 a.e., so ENNReal.ofReal(∫(1 − h) dν) = ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(1 − h(x)) dν (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal).
- By step 3 and monotonicity of ENNReal.ofReal, this is ≤ ∫⁻ ENNReal.ofReal(d(x)) dν (lintegral_mono_ae), which is < ENNReal.ofReal ε by hypothesis.
- Monotonicity of the lower integral needs no measurability, so nothing is required of β or d.
6. Conclusion. ENNReal.ofReal a < ENNReal.ofReal b implies a < b (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff'). So ∫(1 − h) dν < ε, i.e. ν(ℝ^P).toReal − ∫ h dν < ε by step 4, i.e. ν(ℝ^P).toReal − ε < ∫ h dν. If ε ≤ 0, the hypothesis is impossible, since a lower integral is never < ENNReal.ofReal ε = 0; the argument covers this case unchanged. ∎

Lean route (kernel-checked in the frozen contract scope; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
  intro P n ν ξ β ω ε hν hξ hω hωN hG hlt
  have hhm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ξ x (ω x)) ν := isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hξ.prodMk hω.aestronglyMeasurable)
  have hh_int : Integrable (fun x => ξ x (ω x)) ν := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)) hhm ?_
    filter_upwards [hG] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hx.1 (ω x)).trans (hωN x)
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, 0 ≤ 1 - ξ x (ω x) ∧ 1 - ξ x (ω x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - β x) := by
    filter_upwards [hG] with x hx
    have hsplit : ξ x (ω x) = ξ x (β x) + ξ x (ω x - β x) := by rw [← map_add, add_sub_cancel]
    have h1 := (abs_le.1 ((hx.1 (ω x)).trans (hωN x))).2
    have h2 := (abs_le.1 (hx.1 (ω x - β x))).1
    constructor
    · linarith
    · rw [hsplit, hx.2]; linarith
  have h1h_int : Integrable (fun x => 1 - ξ x (ω x)) ν := (integrable_const 1).sub hh_int
  have hint_eq : ∫ x, (1 - ξ x (ω x)) ∂ν = (ν univ).toReal - ∫ x, ξ x (ω x) ∂ν := by
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) hh_int, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, measureReal_def]
  have hofreal : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, (1 - ξ x (ω x)) ∂ν) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal h1h_int (hpt.mono fun x hx => hx.1)]
    calc ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ξ x (ω x)) ∂ν ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - β x)) ∂ν := lintegral_mono_ae (hpt.mono fun x hx => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hx.2)
      _ < ENNReal.ofReal ε := hlt
  have := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff'.1 hofreal).1
  linarith
key_steps: h = ξ(ω) is a.e.-strongly measurable via the continuous bilinear evaluation map, and |h| ≤ N(ω) ≤ 1 a.e., so h ∈ L¹(ν).
A.e., 0 ≤ 1 − h ≤ N(ω − β), using linearity of ξ(x), ξ(x)(β(x)) = 1 and |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ N(α).
ofReal(∫(1 − h)) = ∫⁻ ofReal(1 − h) ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal N(ω − β) < ofReal ε, hence ν(ℝ^P).toReal − ε < ∫ h dν.
